row.evidence: Streak signs users in through their Google account via Google Apps OAuth, team owners add and remove users by hand on the Teams page, and the API says users are created at sign-up and cannot be altered through the API; no SSO or SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Gmail-based CRM. Plans: Pro $49, Pro+ $69, Enterprise $129 per user/month billed annually ($59/$89/$159 monthly); a free tier covers email tools only. Login is Google account OAuth (social sign-in, not customer-IdP SAML/OIDC), so sso_plan is null. Team members are added and removed manually by the team owner; removed users' shared pipeline data stays with the team, and Pro+/Enterprise can archive former users' boxed emails. No SCIM, SAML or JIT is mentioned on the pricing page, security page, help-centre sitemap, site sitemap or API reference. The Streak REST API (Pro and up) can only read the caller's own user and teams. No Okta, Entra or JumpCloud catalogue app (404).

scim.notes: available=false by absence: no SCIM or SAML on the pricing page, security page, www.streak.com sitemap, help-centre sitemap or API reference; users are added manually by the team owner.

endpoints.purpose: Get public details of a user (v1)

user_api.notes: available=false: the API is a data API (pipelines, boxes, contacts, etc.). User objects are created at sign-up and cannot be altered through the API; each API key only accesses its own user. Read-only user and team endpoints are listed. API is on all paid plans (Standard on Pro).

google.notes: Streak is a Gmail extension that signs in with Google Apps OAuth; not checked as a Workspace SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: Owner adds users by name or email on the Teams page; the user then installs the extension and accepts the invitation in their inbox.

citations.title: Streak pricing
citations.quote: Streak costs $49 per user per month on Pro, $69 per user per month on Pro+, and $129 per user per month on Enterprise, billed annually. Monthly billing is $59, $89, and $159.

citations.title: Streak pricing
citations.quote: For teams who want a full CRM in Gmail, with unlimited pipelines and records.

citations.title: Streak pricing
citations.quote: For teams that need custom permissions, data validation rules, and a dedicated support contact.

citations.title: Streak pricing
citations.quote: Modern REST API to connect with your internal systems and workflows.

citations.title: Streak security
citations.quote: we ask for your permission to connect to your Google account, and authenticate that connection via Google Apps OAuth. Your Streak account thus has the same industry-leading login security as your Google account.

citations.title: Add users to your Streak team
citations.quote: If you're a team owner in Streak, you can add users from the Teams page. Adding somebody to your team gives them access to pipelines shared within that team.

citations.title: Remove users from your Streak team
citations.quote: When you remove a user from your Streak Team, their boxes, pipelines, notes, and activity will still be accessible to the rest of your team in shared pipelines.

citations.title: Archived users
citations.quote: This copy allows Pro+ and Enterprise teams to preserve a former teammate’s emails and attachments while also removing the user from Streak and Google Workspace.

citations.title: Get Current User | Streak API
citations.quote: Creation of users is done when a user signs up for Streak and these objects can not be altered through the API. Since API keys are associated with the user, each API key only has privileges to access its own user object.

citations.title: Get User | Streak API
citations.quote: This call will return the public details for the user specified.

citations.title: Get a team | Streak API
citations.quote: Get a specific team by its key. The user making the request must have access to the team in order to make the request successfully

citations.title: Get my teams | Streak API
citations.quote: Users can be on 0 or more teams. This endpoint will return all the teams a user is on.
